subject: Customer video: ZenWell product story — release & script review
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zenwell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Customer video: ZenWell product story — quick next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for agreeing to capture a short customer story with us. We’d love to keep this tight: 60–90s on-camera executive soundbite + 30–45s product B-roll. Goal is a polished web case study and 30s social cut.

Suggested next steps:
- I’ll send a draft script/talking points and the standard release form for legal sign-off.
- PixelWave (cc’ed once confirmed) will propose a two-hour on-site window for interview + 30m B-roll.
- We’ll loop in Marcus (solutions) for any technical questions during the interview.

Are there any compliance or procurement approvals we should be aware of before sending the release? Also, do you have a preferred filming week (we’re targeting Oct 26–30, PT)?

Thanks — excited to tell ZenWell’s story.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: none in this message

Hi Camila —

This sounds great. Quick notes:
- Procurement wants the release before any filming; legal will review but should be straightforward.
- We prefer Oct 28 in the morning (8:30–11:30) — our clinic/operations lead is available then.
- PixelWave is our usual vendor — I’ve cc’d them. Please include a shot list so they can confirm crew and kit.

I’ll be the on-camera lead and Mark (cc) will join for a quick plug about integration details. We do need the final script by Thursday EOD (15 Oct) so legal has time.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Partnerships | ZenWell Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zenwell.com>, Mark Thomason <mthomason@zenwell.com>, PixelWave Production <pixelwave@production.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft script + release form (for legal review)

Hi all —

Per Alicia’s note, please find attached: 
- Redwood_Customer_Release_v1.pdf (standard Redwood release + usage rights)
- zenwell_script_draft_v2.docx (60–90s script with talking points + optional social cut)
- production_shotlist_pixelwave.xlsx (initial shot list from PixelWave)

Key asks:
1) Alicia / ZenWell legal — please confirm the release or send comments by Monday (19 Oct) so we can lock the schedule.
2) Mark — can you review the technical section (paragraph 2 of the script) and flag anything too detailed or proprietary? Marcus is on-hand if you want him to reword.
3) PixelWave — confirm you can operate on Oct 28 8:30–11:30 PT with a two-camera package (interview + gimbal B-roll).

Script highlights (TL;DR):
- Opening (Alicia): high-level value prop of ZenWell and why Redwood matters — 20–30s
- Product shot / cutaway: 20s B-roll showing the Redwood integration in action (dashboard, clinician workflow)
- Closing (Mark): specific outcome/metric (e.g., throughput or time-to-decision improvement) — 15–25s

We purposely kept the technical wording light: "real-time model routing" -> "smart routing to the right models" — but Mark, please suggest edits.

Thanks — attaching files for legal and production.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Customer_Release_v1.pdf, zenwell_script_draft_v2.docx, production_shotlist_pixelwave.xlsx

From: Mark Thomason <mthomason@zenwell.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zenwell.com>, PixelWave Production <pixelwave@production.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft script + release form (for legal review)

Camila / team —

Thanks for the draft. A few quick edits from our side:
- Legal: the release is fine but we need an explicit clause that the footage will not be used in paid advertising without additional approval. Can your legal include that?
- Script: please soften or remove the phrase "real-time model routing" — regulators on our side prefer non-technical phrasing. Suggest: "Smart routing to the most appropriate models for each clinical workflow."
- Metric: we can cite "reduced triage time by ~18%" but need to add "in a pilot study" as a qualifier.

Marcus — happy to sync offline if you'd like to reword the technical paragraph.

PixelWave — once legal confirms the release tweak, we’re good to lock Oct 28 8:30–11:30.

Best,
Mark
CTO (interim) | ZenWell Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zenwell.com>, Mark Thomason <mthomason@zenwell.com>, PixelWave Production <pixelwave@production.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft script + release form (for legal review) — finalized for sign-off + schedule

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

1) Legal tweak added: Redwood_Customer_Release_v1_FINAL.pdf attached (clause: no paid advertising without separate written approval). Alicia, please confirm with procurement that this satisfies the ask.
2) Script updated: technical phrasing changed to "smart routing to the most appropriate models for each workflow" and metric qualified as "in a pilot study". New file: zenwell_script_draft_v2_FINAL.docx attached.
3) PixelWave confirmed two-camera team for Oct 28 8:30–11:30 PT (on-site crew will arrive at 8:00 for set-up).

Day-of plan (brief):
- 8:00 — crew arrives, set-up
- 8:30–9:00 — interview capture with Alicia (20–30m total; multiple takes)
- 9:00–9:30 — Mark on-camera (10–15m) + cutaways
- 9:30–10:15 — B-roll/clinic cutaways (clinical workflows, dashboards)
- 10:15–10:45 — optional soundbites or extra coverage

Action items:
- Alicia / Procurement: confirm release signature by Tue, 20 Oct (we need signed release on file).
- Mark: confirm the revised metric language or send alternative phrasing by Tue EOD.
- Marcus / Monica: we’ll bring a short checklist for network access/guest Wi‑Fi & demo account for the dashboard.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth shoot. I’ve attached the final files and the Drive folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-zenwell-video-deliverables

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_Customer_Release_v1_FINAL.pdf, zenwell_script_draft_v2_FINAL.docx, production_shotlist_pixelwave_final.xlsx
